verdict.rationale: Marqeta's docs show a Transactions API for retrieving authorization data (marqeta-docs-7) and real-time webhooks for API events (marqeta-docs-9, marqeta-docs-20), which support some real-time visibility into money movement, but there is no evidence of a dedicated balance API, a ledger that explicitly ties authorizations to clearing, or settlement reporting/reconciliation tooling. missing for 10: balance/account balance endpoint, explicit auth-to-clearing ledger linkage, settlement reporting or penny-level reconciliation documentation.
